report_scope: fixed 100-sample CV-Bench screening causal diagnostic (forced vs control, same per-sample K_C); NOT a formal full2638 conclusion
explicit_non_formal_statement: Fixed 100-sample screening causal diagnostic: the forced vs control signal is diagnostic only and is NOT a formal full2638 CV-Bench conclusion. It must not be quoted as the official CV-Bench accuracy of any approach.

single_variable_contract.control: control rule, exactly K_C real groups
single_variable_contract.forced: exact frozen shallow_r0250 historical indices, same K_C

primary_metric.rule: the only primary metric for both arms and the only decision metric

unweighted_metric.rule: unweighted sample accuracy is SECONDARY diagnostic only and is never the official CV-Bench metric

control.description: layer-5 control arm: one anchor per non-empty 3x3 region + global L2 ranking, exactly K_C real groups

forced.description: layer-5 forced arm: exactly the frozen shallow_r0250 historical indices, same K_C real groups

decision.scope_note: screening100 causal diagnostic only; this is NOT a full-dataset (2638-sample) conclusion

limitations: Screening100 is a fixed diagnostic subset, not the formal 2638-sample benchmark.
The relaxed K_C alignment is a diagnostic setting; it is NOT an FPGA-deployable candidate.
Both arms run the same unified forward; the only variable is selected_group_indices.
Forbidden primary metrics (pointing/grounding/ndcg/retained_mass) are never reported.
Timings are descriptive only and never enter the decision.
Neither arm uses the B1-trained Wv projection.
